name: InkBloom
tagline: Booking software built for the people who run the chair, not a call center.
positioning: InkBloom gives independent tattoo studios one calm place to book consults, collect deposits, and keep every artist's schedule in sync.

hero.h1: Booking that respects the artist and the client.
hero.sub: InkBloom handles consults, deposits, waivers, and every artist's calendar in one place — so your studio spends less time on the phone and more time under the needle.

features.title: Deposits that actually stick
features.description: Collect non-refundable deposits at booking and auto-apply them to the final session. No more no-shows eating a Saturday slot.

features.title: One calendar per chair
features.description: Every artist gets their own bookable schedule with buffers, day-off blocks, and healing-time gaps between big pieces.

features.title: Consults without the DM chaos
features.description: Reference photos, placement, and sizing land in a tidy request instead of scattered across Instagram and text messages.

features.title: Waivers signed before they arrive
features.description: Digital consent forms and aftercare go out with the confirmation, stored against each appointment for good.

features.title: Flash drops that sell out
features.description: Post a sheet, set a claim window, and let clients grab designs first-come — payment and slot locked in one tap.

features.title: Numbers you can trust
features.description: See booked revenue, deposit balances, and each artist's fill rate without exporting a single spreadsheet.

testimonials.quote: We were losing two or three appointments a week to no-shows. InkBloom's deposits fixed that in the first month, and my artists finally stopped double-booking themselves.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: Flash drops used to be a comment-section free-for-all. Now clients claim a design and pay in one step, and I know exactly who's coming in.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: Adding a new artist used to mean explaining our whole system. With InkBloom I give them a seat and they're booking their own chair by the afternoon.
testimonials.name: Priya Kessler

homepage.footerBlurb: InkBloom is booking software for independent tattoo studios — built with artists, for the people who actually run the chair.
